football_evidence.question: Can Kennesaw State contain Liberty’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward Liberty, and its own breakdown accounts for about 0.0 of the 3.0 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.
supporting: When Kennesaw State has the ball (big plays through the air): Kennesaw State’s offense turns 7.0% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Liberty’s defense gives up explosive gains on 7.1% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When Kennesaw State has the ball (big plays on the ground): Kennesaw State’s offense turns 2.4% of its runs into explosive gains, and Liberty’s defense gives up explosive gains on 6.3% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Kennesaw State has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Kennesaw State’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 20.4% of its runs, and Liberty’s defense stops 23.4% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.3%).

When Liberty has the ball (big plays on the ground): Liberty’s offense turns 12.7% of its runs into explosive gains, and Kennesaw State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 3.7% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).
contradicting: When Kennesaw State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Kennesaw State’s offense has allowed a sack on 2.5% of its dropbacks, and Liberty’s defense sacks the quarterback on 8.2% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
In his last two games (Delaware and Sam Houston), Purdie averaged 7.8 yards per attempt, against 9.5 in his four games before that.
In his last two games (Jacksonville State and Missouri State), Collins averaged 7.8 yards per attempt, against 6.4 in his four games before that.
quarterbacks: Rickie Collins has completed 130 of 188 passes (69.1%) for 1,302 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 3 interceptions in six games for Kennesaw State, and has been sacked on 5 of 193 dropbacks.
Deshawn Purdie has completed 69 of 115 passes (60.0%) for 1,038 yards, 9.0 yards per attempt, 8 touchdowns and no interceptions in six games for Liberty, and has been sacked on 13 of 128 dropbacks.
